breakdown.description: The domain height and initial water column are oriented along the Y-axis, but the gravity vector is set to the -Z direction, which will not cause the dam to break downwards.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The specification describes a 2D simulation in the XY plane, with the domain height and water column defined along the Y-axis. However, the gravity vector is still set to `(0 0 -9.81)`, which acts in the Z-direction. For the simulation to work as intended (a dam break in the XY plane), the gravity vector should have been corrected to act in the negative Y-direction, for example, `(0 -9.81 0)`.
